label: is subject of
definition: x is subject of y =Def y is about x.

label: is about
definition: x is_about y is a primitive relationship between an instance of Information Content Entity x and an instance of Entity y.

label: is an ordinal measurement of
definition: x is_an_ordinal_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity and y is_measured_by_ordinal x.

label: is excerpted from
definition: An Information Bearing Entity b1 is excerpted from another Information Bearing Entity B2 iff b1 is part of some Information Bearing Entity B1 that is carrier of some Information Content Entity C1, B2 is carrier of some Information Content Entity C2, C1 is not identical with C2, b1 is carrier of some Information Content Entity c1, b2 is an Information Bearing Entity that is part of B2 and b2 is carrier of c1 (i.e. the same Information Content Entity as borne by b1).

label: time zone identifier used by
definition: x time_zone_identifier_used_by y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Time Zone Identifier, such that x designates the spatial region associated with the time zone mentioned in y.

label: uses measurement unit
definition: x uses measurement unit y =Def y is measurement unit of x.

label: is a nominal measurement of
definition: x is_a_nominal_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Nominal Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x classifies y relative to some set of shared, possibly arbitrary, characteristics.

label: represented by
definition: x represented by y =Def y represents x.

label: is an interval measurement of
definition: x is_an_interval_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Interval Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity and y is_measured_by_interval x.

label: is mention of
definition: x is mention of y =Def y is mentioned by x.

label: designated by
definition: x designated by y =Def y designates x.

label: condition described by
definition: x condition described by y =Def y describes condition x.

label: language used in
definition: x language_used_by y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Language, such that the literal value of y is a string that is encoded according to the syntax of x.

label: is geospatial coordinate reference system of
definition: x is_geospatial_coordinate_reference_system_of y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Geospatial Coordinate Reference System, such that x describes the set of standards mentioned in y.

label: is measured by
definition: x is measured by y =Def y is a measurement of x.

label: uses time zone identifier
definition: x uses time zone identifier y =Def y time zone identifier used by x.

label: uses reference system
definition: x uses reference system y =Def y is reference system of x.

label: uses geospatial coordinate reference system
definition: x uses geospatial coordinate reference system y =Def y is geospatial coordinate reference system of x.

label: is measured by nominal
definition: x is measured by nominal y =Def y is a nominal measurement of x.

label: designates
definition: x designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities.

label: described by
definition: x described by y =Def y describes x.

label: is mentioned by
definition: x is_mentioned_by y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Entity, such that y is used as a reference to x.

label: prescribed by
definition: x prescribed by y =Def y prescribes x.

label: represents
definition: x represents y iff x is an instance of Representational Information Content Entity, y is an instance of Entity, and z is carrier of x, such that x is about y in virtue of there existing an isomorphism between characteristics of z and y.

label: prescribes
definition: x prescribes y iff x is an instance of Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x serves as a rule or guide for y if y an Occurrent, or x serves as a model for y if y is a Continuant.

label: is measurement unit of
definition: x is_measurement_unit_of y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Measurement Unit, such that x describes the magnitude of measured physical quantity mentioned in y.

label: is measured by ordinal
definition: x is measured by ordinal y =Def y is a ordinal measurement of x.

label: is measured by interval
definition: x is measured by interval y =Def y is a interval measurement of x.

label: is measured by ratio
definition: x is measured by ratio y =Def y is a ratio measurement of x.

label: is a measurement of
definition: x is_a_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x describes some attribute of y relative to some scale or classification scheme.

label: uses language
definition: x uses language y =Def y language used in x.

label: describes condition
definition: p describes_condition c iff p is an instance of a Performance Specification and c is an instance of Entity and p has part d, and d is an instance of a Descriptive Information Content Entity, and p prescribes an entity s, and d describes c, and c is an entity that is causally relevant to s existing as prescribed by p.

label: describes
definition: x describes y iff x is an instance of Descriptive Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of Entity, such that x is_about the characteristics that identify y.

label: is a ratio measurement of
definition: x is_a_ratio_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity and x describes some attribute of y relative to a scale having equal unit values and a zero value that corresponds to the absence of the attribute being measured.

label: is reference system of
definition: x is_reference_system_of y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Reference System, such that x describes the set of standards mentioned in y.

label: has date value
definition: A data property that has as its range a date value.

label: Designative Name

label: Temporal Reference System

label: Cartesian Coordinate System
definition: A Spatial Reference System that identifies each point in a spatial region of n-dimensions using an ordered n-tuple of numerical coordinates that are the signed (i.e. positive or negative) distances measured in the same unit of length from the zero point where the fixed perpendicular Coordinate System Axes meet.
enriched_definition: A cartesian coordinate system is a Spatial Reference System that identifies each point in a spatial region of n dimensions using an ordered n-tuple of numerical coordinates that are signed distances, measured in the same unit of length, from the zero point where fixed, mutually perpendicular coordinate system axes meet.
differentia: identifies each point in a spatial region of n dimensions using an ordered n-tuple of numerical coordinates that are signed distances, measured in the same unit of length, from the zero point where fixed, mutually perpendicular coordinate system axes meet

label: Greenwich Mean Time Zone Identifier

label: Interval Measurement Information Content Entity

enriched_definition: A database is a media content entity that is designed to be rapidly searchable and retrievable.

enriched_definition: A video is a media content entity that has part a sequence of images presented sufficiently rapidly to create the appearance of motion and continuity.
differentia: that has part a sequence of images presented sufficiently rapidly to create the appearance of motion and continuity

enriched_definition: A message is a media content entity that is relatively brief and is designed to be transmitted from a sender to a recipient.

differentia: that is about a scenario that has been determined to merit attention by a recipient

enriched_definition: A document content entity is a media content entity that consists of a series of paragraphs of text or diagrams that are intended to be carried by physical pieces of paper or an electronic word processing file.

label: Twenty-Four-Hour Clock Time System
definition: A Clock Time System for time keeping in which the Day runs from midnight to midnight and is divided into 24 Hours, indicated by the Hours passed since midnight, from 0 to 23.

label: Julian Calendar
definition: A Solar Calendar System that has a regular Year of 365 24-Hour Days divided into 12 Months with a leap day added at the end of February every 4 Years such that the average length of a Julian Year is 365.25 Days.

label: Twelve-Hour Clock Time System
definition: A Clock Time System for keeping the Time of Day in which the Day runs from midnight to midnight and is divided into two intervals of 12 Hours each, where: the first interval begins at midnight, ends at noon, and is indicated by the suffix 'a.m.'; the second interval begins at noon, ends at midnight, and is indicated by the suffix 'p.m.'; and the midnight and noon Hours are numbered 12 with subsequent Hours numbered 1-11.

label: Earth-Centered Earth-Fixed Coordinate System
definition: A Geospatial and Cartesian Coordinate System that identifies positions using an x-axis, y-axis, and z-axis coordinate where the zero point is the center of the Earth, the z-Axis extends toward the North Pole but does not always coincide exactly with the Earth's Axis of Rotation, the x-Axis extends through the intersection of the Prime Meridian and the Equator, the y-Axis completes the right-handed system, and all three axes are fixed to the Earth such that they rotate along with the Earth.

label: Gregorian Calendar
definition: A Solar Calendar System that has a regular Year of 365 24-Hour Days divided into 12 Months with a leap day added at the end of February every 4 Years except Years that are evenly divisible by 100 but not 400 such that there are 97 leap Years every 400 Years and the average length of a Gregorian Year is 365.2425 Days (365 Days 5 Hours 49 Minutes 12 Seconds).
